purpose: Define the minimum governed product signals needed to measure demonstrated SongChart product outcomes without turning telemetry into canonical music-domain truth or privileged audit.

search.performed.producer: app/Http/Controllers/Search/SearchController.php after BuildSearchPage returns a valid non-empty-query result
search.performed.purpose: Measure actual search demand volume and provide the denominator for zero-result and recovery metrics.
search.performed.guardrail: query normalization must not fabricate canonical entity identity

search.zero_result.producer: app/Http/Controllers/Search/SearchController.php when BuildSearchPage returns zero results for a valid non-empty query
search.zero_result.purpose: Measure unmet search demand and create evidence for later zero-result recovery and data-opportunity prioritization.
search.zero_result.guardrail: zero-result evidence may prioritize review/enrichment but cannot mutate canonical data directly

entity.viewed.purpose: Potentially measure public entity exposure, but no accepted downstream metric/action currently requires persistence.

activation_gate.rule: Contract approval does not authorize persistence by itself.
